headline: LAD @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 5.61 at SDP 3.73, with a projected total of 9.35. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +1.46 runs while SDP moved +0.35, changing the projected margin by +1.11 runs. The projected total climbed +1.80, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -25.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Emmet Sheehan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Miguel Andujar, Teoscar Hernández, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Dalton Rushing, Jackson Merrill because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
